title: Aqueduct of Valens
visualBrief: Both surviving Valens Aqueduct masonry components in Istanbul: actual deep open arches and thick piers, central two-tier arcade with semicircular/occasional pointed arch profiles, single-tier end remains, continuous high channel and low parapets, thin tier ledge, pale stone and occasional brick voussoir repairs. Exact native outlines/all61XZcontrols and missing gap retained. No reconstructed lost connecting section, road/property slab, whole water network, traffic/mosque/neighbors/vegetation/signs or interiors.
